title: iHeartPodcasts Debuts “Whatever It Takes with Carli Lloyd and Jenny Taft,” A New Series Covering Each Week in Sports, Family and What Defines Greatness
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK – September 10, 2026 –** iHeartPodcasts, the No. 1 podcast publisher according to[Podtrac](https://analytics.podtrac.com/podcast-publisher-rankings) , today announced “[Whatever It Takes with Carli Lloyd and Jenny Taft](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-whatever-it-takes-with-ca-343052053) ,” hosted by longtime friends and broadcast partners Carli Lloyd, iconic two-time World Cup champion and Olympic gold medalist, and Jenny Taft, one of sports television’s premier sideline reporters and studio hosts. The weekly sports and culture show will join the iHeart Soccer Network today, with new episodes available on Thursdays. Fans can hear the first episode now,[here](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-whatever-it-takes-with-ca-343052053) .


Each week hosts Carli Lloyd and Jenny Taft will sit down on “Whatever It Takes,” a series where two friends who have been, and continue to be, at the top of their games, will discuss the week in sports, family and the ever-evolving definition of greatness. Becoming champions and top-tier sports broadcasters doesn't come easy and balancing that with motherhood and partnership is a masterclass in resilience.


"Jenny and I have developed a great friendship over the years, and I’m thrilled to team up with her and iHeartPodcasts on this new venture,” said Lloyd. "‘Whatever It Takes’ is a space where we can share our experiences, learn from incredible guests and talk openly about the challenges and triumphs that come with pursuing your goals both on and off the field."


“I first crossed paths with Carli Lloyd while covering the 2015 Women’s World Cup,” said Taft. “From the very beginning, I was struck by the way she carried herself both on and off the pitch; her relentless work ethic and unwavering commitment to greatness remain deeply inspiring. Over the past few years, it has been an absolute privilege to transition from covering Carli’s career to calling her a friend and fellow colleague. It has been equally special to watch her embrace motherhood and navigate this exciting new chapter. Now, we are thrilled to team up with iHeartPodcasts and share our stories—tackling everything from the beautiful game to the realities of being working moms. Ultimately, we are all just trying to figure out how to do whatever it takes to juggle it all, and we cannot wait for everyone to join us on this incredible ride.”


In their premiere episode, Carli Lloyd and Jenny Taft will share the story behind the creation of the podcast, reflect on World Cups past and present, and open-up about balancing career, family and motherhood. It will be an open and authentic conversation about chasing dreams, shifting into new phases of life and what it truly means to do whatever it takes. Throughout the series, the hosts will also welcome special guests including former soccer players and sports analysts Stu Holden and Alexi Lalas to weigh in on all things life and sports.


“Carli and Jenny are legends in their respective fields, but what makes them truly special is that they are also bold, relatable voices people genuinely want to hear from,” said Leo Gomez, head of the iHeart Soccer Network. “We’re thrilled they’re stepping into this new chapter with iHeart and bringing audiences beyond the headlines and highlight reels. Get ready to be inspired by their professional journeys, their personal stories and the remarkable guests joining them along the way. This is the kind of honest, energizing and deeply human show we all need right now.”


“[Whatever It Takes with Carli Lloyd and Jenny Taft](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-whatever-it-takes-with-ca-343052053) ” is part of the iHeart Soccer network and is distributed by iHeartPodcasts. It is available now on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard. Video episodes will be available on iHeart and YouTube.

**About Carli Lloyd**


Carli Lloyd is a two-time Olympic gold medalist, two-time World Cup champion, studio analyst, and New York Times bestselling author. One of the most decorated players in U.S. soccer history, she earned FIFA World Player of the Year honors twice and played 17 years with the USWNT, becoming the team’s all-time leading Olympic scorer and the first player ever to record a hat trick in a Women’s World Cup Final. She appeared in more World Cup and Olympic matches than any American player, finishing her career with 134 goals in 316 caps and earning induction into the National Soccer Hall of Fame in 2025.


**About Jenny Taft**


Jenny Taft is a FOX Sports broadcaster and former collegiate athlete, best known as the lead reporter for the network’s top college football games on BIG NOON SATURDAY and FIFA World Cup coverage on FOX. She’s covered 6 World Cups major events including the FIFA Women’s World Cup (2019, 2023), the 2018, 2022 and 2026 FIFA World Cups, and the Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show. Taft began her career with FOX Sports North in her native Minnesota before joining FS1 at its launch, quickly rising from update anchor to field reporter and studio host. A standout lacrosse player at Boston University, she brings her athletic background and versatility to every assignment. Taft lives in Boston with her husband, Olympian Matt Gilroy and daughter Gigi.
